metadata.description: Safety and productivity mods for Claude Code, built for scientists.

plugins.name: aside
plugins.description: /aside <question> asks a quick side question over your current context and shows the answer in a pane, without adding anything to the conversation.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky Bash commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push, DROP TABLE ...), shows exactly what they would destroy, and asks first. A safety net, not a permission system.

plugins.name: branch-janitor
plugins.description: Watches your git branches by itself (nothing to type) and notices when a branch's work is done (merged, squash-merged, pull request merged), even if you merged in a plain terminal. Checks it is safe to delete and offers to delete it. Never deletes without a click; the remote copy is a second, separate question.

plugins.name: budget-guard
plugins.description: A quiet usage line above the prompt that appears only when cost, context or your plan window needs a look, and an optional spending limit that asks before the next prompt instead of refusing. Type usage for a short report.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Stops you once before a message that would re-write a cold prompt cache, shows the price, and can keep the cache warm with /keepwarm.

plugins.name: diagram
plugins.description: Draws the last mermaid diagram from Claude's answer as box art in a pane: type diagram to open it. Flowcharts, sequence diagrams and pie charts; offline, no model tokens.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: The project's file tree in a pane beside the chat, lit up as Claude reads, edits and commits files. Read-only.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Turns your corrections ("no, use pnpm", "never do X") into rules you can save to CLAUDE.md with one click.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: /replay (or just typing replay) steps through every file edit Claude made in the last turn (or the session), one diff at a time.

plugins.name: review-cost
plugins.description: Before a git push triggers the automatic second-model review, shows its estimated token cost (green / amber / red) and lets you choose Review or Skip.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Live band and pane for Claude's plan tasks and subagents: task and helper progress bars, a subagent tree, tokens, est. cost, time and tool counts.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Keeps secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords, private keys) out of the model's context: hides them in tool output and asks before a typed prompt that contains one is sent.

plugins.name: suggest-model
plugins.description: Checks every prompt locally (zero tokens). When the current model is likely too weak or overkill, it blocks the prompt and shows a dialog ("Don't use X for this task"), recommending the model with the best predicted fit per cost.

plugins.name: tool-skins
plugins.description: Restyles tool-call rows and Edit/Write diff cards in seven colour themes; /skin <theme> (or typing skins / skin <theme>) switches live.

plugins.name: toolbox
plugins.description: A side bar listing every mod and skill, one boxed row each: click a switch (green on, red off) to flip it, pick a skin from a dropdown, or click any other row to put its command in the prompt box.
